samples.question: Find the four grayscale panels, each with a matching pair of colored edge marks. The two marks indicate which outside corner the panel belongs to: marks on the top and left mean upper-left, top and right mean upper-right, bottom and left mean lower-left, and bottom and right mean lower-right. Crop each panel's interior, place the four panels into that 2x2 order, average each 9x9 square of the reconstructed raster using edge replication, and read the broad dark symbol. Which appears: spiral, fork, bracket, or petal?
